summary: This spacious 2 bedroom apartment is perfect for families and business travelers.

description.Space:
This spacious 2 bedroom apartment is perfect for families and business travelers. 

The 2 bedroom apartment includes a spacious reception area with a combined living that includes a bright outdoor balcony.  There is a fully equipped kitchen, cooking utensils and a Nespresso coffee machine. The living room is furnished with a sofa set along with a 55 inch smart TV with AirPlay built-in for further personal entertainment. There is full bathrooms one of which is equipped with a shower. 
The first bedroom includes a king size bed & along with a spacious walk in dressing room.
The second bedroom includes two single beds. 

Please note the following: 
- Smoking is only allowed outside the building (a fine of $100 will be imposed when smoking indoors) 
- Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests will be granted entry. 
- Free of charge street parking is available.

 • Cancellation more than 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 10% of the total price of the stay.
 • Cancellation between 15 days and 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 50% of the total price of the stay. 
• Cancellation between 7 days and 15 days before the arrival date, we keep 75% of the total price of the stay.
• Less than 7 days, we keep 100% of the price of the stay
• Pets are not allowed, in case of violation, Xuru Stays has the right to cancel the reservation with no refund. 

Thank you for choosing our home for your Holiday.
We hope that you have a pleasant stay.

Xuru Stays

I had a great stay at this apartment — it matches the description and photos exactly. It's located in an older part of Cairo, so while the exterior of the building and stairwell show their age, the apartment itself has clearly been renovated. Inside, everything was neat, clean, and well taken care of.

The location is very convenient, with plenty of grocery stores, pharmacies, and restaurants nearby. It's also within walking distance of both a church and a mosque, which I really appreciated.

The host was fantastic — very communicative and regularly checked in to make sure everything was going smoothly. They even offered a complimentary cleaning service during my stay, which was a lovely touch.

If I had to suggest one improvement, it would be to add a small first aid kit in the apartment for emergencies. Otherwise, everything was excellent. Would definitely stay again!

Positive:
Location is good, apartment is roomy and cozy, self check-in was quick and easy.

Negative:
Apartment wasn’t to the desired cleanliness, internet was down for most of our stay, staff was unable to resolve our issues in a timely manner, dogs bark and howl all night.
The host was very responsive and helped us throughout our stay. The house was very spacious and we loved our stay.

Beautiful place! The architecture is gorgeous and very thoughtful details! The balconies were amazing! I booked the place last minute and had some issues finding out how to get in, but they were there for me late night to help me. I didn’t check in, until about midnight Egyptian time - so I think the experience would have been different if I booked more than a day in advance and arrived earlier. One thing to consider is the Airbnb map will not lead you to the location. It took me to another place about 10-15 minutes away! You have to use the coordinates listed in the instructions to find it - not just the map or address, and then the key pad is on the door on the gated door entrance into the building. Customer service was there with me throughout my stay and the apartment was so comfy! I’d live there if I could!

If you look at the pictures you will get what you see... until you look closely and nothing actually works. Mould growing in the bathroom, showers that flood because drains don't drain. A giant squigee in the bathroom because clearly the host knows this is required to maintain the flooding every time you shower. Floors are disgustingly dirty. No cleaning tools other than an old broom that has loose and dirty bristles. The cups are placed on top of toilet paper. The gas also stopped working on our second day. It took over half a day to rectify and I was livid to learn why it was cut - the prepaid 'payment' card had run out of money. Coming to this airbnb with an infant felt unsafe and unreliable. We wanted to leave early. The host compensated us 50% of our fee. Even so this didn't change that our trip was made unnecessarily difficult and upsetting.
